retry_enabled.label: Enable Retry
retry_enabled.help: Whether to automatically retry on API request failure.

retry_max_retries.label: Max Retries
retry_max_retries.help: Maximum number of retries for a single request before reporting an error, default 3.

retry_initial_delay.label: Initial Delay
retry_initial_delay.help: Wait time before the first retry (in seconds), default 1.0.

retry_max_delay.label: Max Delay
retry_max_delay.help: Upper limit of backoff delay (in seconds) to prevent unlimited growth, default 60.0.

retry_exponential_base.label: Exponential Base
retry_exponential_base.help: Each retry delay is multiplied by this base, default 2.0 (1s -> 2s -> 4s -> 8s...).
